clue.text: Short-sighted?

parts.note: read not as having poor eyesight but as having taken only a short, quick look at something

explanation.surface: A one-word query about whether someone has poor eyesight.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a brief look at something is to have a sight of it that is short.

clue.text: Porter who sees magnate well-served

indicators.note: well-served suggests the letters of magnate are dished out in a new order

explanation.surface: A doorman spots that a tycoon is being well looked after.
explanation.definitionFit: A porter keeps the gate of a building or estate.

clue.text: Made bubbly

parts.note: read as having had gas forced in so that it fizzes, like a soft drink

explanation.surface: Someone or something turned cheerful.
explanation.definitionFit: Fizzy drinks have carbon dioxide forced into them to make them effervescent.

clue.text: Jar in which pound may be kept in ready money

indicators.note: the pound symbol is stored inside the money word

parts.note: cash, money available in hand
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A pot in which spare pounds are saved as cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jar' suggests a container, but here it means a jolt or conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: A jar is a jolt or discordant shock, as is a collision of opposed things.

clue.text: Sound gear possibly, but it's not at all safe

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters of sound gear could be rearranged

explanation.surface: Audio equipment that may be risky to use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' makes the answer from the letters of SOUNDGEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hazardous carries risk of harm.

clue.text: Letter written about men's new estate

indicators.note: the spelt-out letter goes around the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: the letter D written out in full as a word

indicators.note: new suggests the letters of the word men's are made into a fresh order

parts.note: the possessive 's counts as a letter S here

explanation.surface: Someone writes a letter about a fresh estate belonging to some men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter written' means the letter's name spelt out; 'new' signals the anagram and 'about' the enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A demesne is land attached to a manor, a landed estate held by its owner.

clue.text: Put in order for outfit

explanation.surface: Tidying things up for a costume.
explanation.definitionFit: To dress ranks is to align them; a dress is a garment or outfit.

clue.text: Incompetent and heartless doctor a lot aim to change

indicators.note: to change tells the solver these letters must be put into a different order
heartless means the inner letters of the word doctor are removed, leaving its first and last

explanation.surface: A useless, uncaring doctor and many others set out to change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' leaves DR from doctor; 'to change' rearranges DR + ALOTAIM.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy, inept person is lacking in skill.

clue.text: She's always scored highly

parts.note: scored read as written in a musical score, with a high vocal part, not as gaining marks

explanation.surface: A woman who always gets top marks.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the highest female singing voice, its parts written at the top of the score.

clue.text: The English reader is a choosy individual

parts.note: a lector is a reader, especially one reading lessons in church or lecturing at a university

explanation.surface: An English reader is fussy.
explanation.definitionFit: A voter is someone who chooses, selecting candidates.

clue.text: Coach without hesitation giving ground

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the coaching word goes round the other

parts.note: to coach is to train someone
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A sports coach who never hesitates gives up ground to rivals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain is a stretch of land considered for its physical features.

clue.text: A quarter strike, a quarter hide

parts.note: east is one of the four quarters of the compass
to clip is to hit or strike
south-east, another compass quarter

explanation.surface: Instructions to hit one quarter and hide in another.
explanation.walkthrough: Compass points count as quarters: E for east, SE for south-east.
explanation.definitionFit: To eclipse is to obscure or block from view.

clue.text: Unapproachable, like any unemployed sportsman

explanation.surface: An unrivalled player who cannot get a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Unapproachable means without equal, peerless; an unemployed sportsman has no fixture to play in.

clue.text: Drawing many a primitive form of transport

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, so a large number
a raft, logs lashed together to float people across water

explanation.surface: A picture of lots of early vehicles.
explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a preliminary sketch or plan.

clue.text: Dig and get back say brownish

indicators.note: back tells the solver to read the whole run of letters from say and brownish from right to left

parts.note: say means for example, abbreviated eg
dun is a dull greyish-brown colour

explanation.surface: Someone digs, gets back and remarks on a brownish colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns EG + DUN as one run, giving NUD GE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dig in the ribs is a poke with the elbow.

clue.text: Antagonises sergeants in mess

indicators.note: in mess suggests the letters of sergeants are in a muddle

explanation.surface: Sergeants in the mess hall upset others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mess' looks like the military dining room, but signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to turn them hostile.

clue.text: Out of sorts? Looking green?

explanation.surface: Two questions about someone who seems unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling out of sorts is being slightly ill, and looking green is the pale sickly complexion of someone not well.

clue.text: Food for the outdoor type must be a bird

parts.note: field as in field sports, done outdoors
fare means food

explanation.surface: Food for a hiker turns out to be a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A fieldfare is a large thrush that visits Britain in winter.

clue.text: Replacing cracked tea-set as a preliminary

parts.note: for in the sense of in place of, replacing

indicators.note: cracked suggests the tea-set is broken up and its letters reassembled

explanation.surface: A broken set of crockery is being replaced.
explanation.definitionFit: A foretaste is a sample or anticipation of something still to come.

clue.text: Point put to a country girl

parts.note: France, a European country
S, south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A point is made to a girl from the country.
explanation.definitionFit: Frances is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Anger about turn-over in the underground system

indicators.note: about means the anger word goes around the other piece

parts.note: rage, intense anger

indicators.note: turn tells the solver the word for over is reversed

parts.note: too means excessively, over

explanation.surface: Fury about an overturned piece of underground plumbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' signals the reversal of the over word, and 'about' the enclosure; 'too' meaning over is as in over-cautious.
explanation.definitionFit: Rootage is a plant's root network, its hidden system below the soil.

clue.text: Running water, and that's material

explanation.surface: A river and a fabric that share a name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tweed is a river on the Scottish border, and tweed is a rough woollen cloth.

clue.text: Intrinsic feature of a German city church

parts.note: Essen, an industrial city in the Ruhr
CE is the abbreviation for Church of England

explanation.surface: A defining feature of a German city's church.
explanation.definitionFit: The essence of something is its fundamental nature.

clue.text: Around the beginning of March insects appear inactive

indicators.note: the two insect words go around the other piece

parts.note: a dor is a dung beetle
an ant is an insect

indicators.note: the beginning of means just the first letter of March

explanation.surface: Insects appear dormant until early March.
explanation.walkthrough: 'insects' supplies two insects, a dor being an old name for a dung beetle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something resting or asleep is not currently active.

clue.text: Bouquet offered in an extra-romantic way

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit within the words extra-romantic

explanation.surface: Flowers given in an especially romantic manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bouquet' suggests flowers, but here it means the smell of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine's bouquet is its characteristic scent.

clue.text: Really friendless furniture restorer

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Really friendless furniture restorer', gives no parse for REDRESSER: 'Really friendless' builds nothing, likely an OCR garble, and no source found the printed clue.

clue.text: A sculptor requiring staff at home

parts.note: a rod is a staff or stick
in means at home

explanation.surface: An artist needs a walking stick around the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Auguste Rodin was the French sculptor of The Thinker.

clue.text: Chemical compound found in pesticides-terribly harmful

indicators.note: found in signals that the letters sit inside pesticides-terribly

explanation.surface: A chemical in pesticides is terribly harmful.
explanation.definitionFit: Esters are organic compounds formed from an acid and an alcohol.

clue.text: Caught, suspended, and reformed

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
hanged, executed by hanging

explanation.surface: A criminal is caught and hanged, and in the process reformed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something altered or made different has been reformed.

clue.text: One may feel "X" is in a woman's clutches

indicators.note: the woman holds the other piece inside her, as if clutching it

parts.note: Anna is a woman's name
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A woman holds a letter X, the mark of a kiss.
explanation.walkthrough: X as a Roman numeral is TEN.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's feeler is the sense organ it touches things with.

clue.text: It's top gear for the cattle man!

definitions.text: It's top gear for the cattle man!

parts.words: It's top gear for the cattle man!
parts.note: top gear read literally as clothing for the head, worn by a cowboy

explanation.surface: Praise for the finest kit a rancher can own.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the broad-brimmed hat associated with American cowboys.

clue.text: Down-payment made, a hearing-aid can be sent

parts.note: the ear is the organ that helps one hear

indicators.note: can be suggests the word sent may be turned into another arrangement

explanation.surface: Once a deposit is paid, a hearing device can be dispatched.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest money is a deposit paid as a pledge to complete a deal.
